about: What the legacy reading of a stored ledger entry (one that recorded no source and no facts) resolves a bare tool name to, frozen so that no later change to a shipped declaration changes how a stored run reads. `tools`: each tool name the platform's built-in declarations covered and the facts they declared for it (every field the declaration set), in the order the first source declaring a name was read. `legacy_names`: the names each consumer's table held that no built-in tool has. Read only for an entry with no source and no facts; never extended.
source: Cut from the platform's own built-in declarations (the built-in servers, the provider-owned blocks and the in-process sources) and its consumer tables, as they stood on 2026-10-27. Written for this project, not copied from a third-party table.

capa.does_not_show: whether the matched code runs, or a capability no rule describes
capa.shows: the capabilities whose capa rules match features of the file, its code and its structure

strings.does_not_show: strings that are encoded, encrypted, compressed or built at run time; nor runs shorter than min_len, or past this page (read next_offset)
strings.shows: printable ASCII and UTF-16LE runs as they sit in the file, with their offsets

check_domain_reputation.does_not_show: whether the sample contacts the domain, or what it would send there
check_domain_reputation.shows: what VirusTotal reports of the domain: its engine counts and categories

check_hash.does_not_show: this run's own analysis of the sample; an unknown hash or no detections is no evidence that the file is clean
check_hash.shows: what VirusTotal reports of the hash: its engine counts and details of the file

check_ip_reputation.does_not_show: whether the sample contacts the address, or what it would send there
check_ip_reputation.shows: what VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB report of the address

get_file_report.does_not_show: this run's own analysis of the sample; an unknown hash or no detections is no evidence that the file is clean
get_file_report.shows: what VirusTotal holds for the hash: its engines' detections and file details

die_scan.does_not_show: what the code does, or a packer or compiler no signature describes; a name is a signature match, not a proof
die_scan.shows: the packers, compilers, linkers, protectors, installers and libraries Detect It Easy's signatures name in the file, with the format each was found in

dotnet_types.does_not_show: what any of them does, or types built or loaded at run time
dotnet_types.shows: the classes, interfaces, structs, delegates and enums the assembly defines

dotnet_decompile_type.does_not_show: what runs at run time: code loaded, decrypted or emitted while the assembly runs, or native code beside the IL
dotnet_decompile_type.shows: C# (or IL) that ILSpy decompiled from the assembly's metadata and IL

dotnet_decompile_member.does_not_show: what runs at run time: code loaded, decrypted or emitted while the assembly runs, or native code beside the IL
dotnet_decompile_member.shows: C# (or IL) that ILSpy decompiled from the assembly's metadata and IL

dotnet_decompile_assembly.does_not_show: what runs at run time: code loaded, decrypted or emitted while the assembly runs, or native code beside the IL
dotnet_decompile_assembly.shows: C# (or IL) that ILSpy decompiled from the assembly's metadata and IL

dotnet_resources.shows: the names of the resources embedded in the assembly

dotnet_metadata_table.does_not_show: how the rows are used by the code
dotnet_metadata_table.shows: every row of one ECMA-335 metadata table as the assembly holds it

go_symbols.does_not_show: what a function does, or code that is not Go
go_symbols.shows: the Go version, build id and build info, and each function's name, package and address range, read from the Go runtime's own tables in the file

go_types.does_not_show: how the types are used, or types of a Go version it misreads
go_types.shows: the Go type structures and interfaces the binary's moduledata lists

go_strings.does_not_show: strings built, decoded or decrypted at run time
go_strings.shows: the strings the binary's Go string table holds, each cut where Go cuts it

yarax_scan.does_not_show: rules that are not in the mounted rule files, or that YARA-X could not compile (named in rules_not_compiled); a match is the rule author's claim, not a verdict
yarax_scan.shows: the operator's own YARA rules (the rule files mounted on the server) that match the file, with each matching string's offset and the rule's metadata

ole_vba.does_not_show: what a macro does when it runs: no macro is run, so code it builds or downloads at run time is not seen
ole_vba.shows: the VBA source of each macro module and olevba's keyword analysis of it (auto-run triggers, suspicious calls, IOCs, encoded strings), Excel 4 macro sheets and VBA stomping

ole_macro_risk.does_not_show: whether a macro is malicious or what it does: a keyword match on the source, with no macro run
ole_macro_risk.shows: whether the macros run on their own and write or execute, by keyword rules

ole_indicators.does_not_show: the content behind an indicator, or anything oleid has no check for
ole_indicators.shows: the document's format, encryption, VBA and XLM macros, external relationships, Flash and object pools, each with oleid's risk rating

rtf_objects.does_not_show: what an object does when it is opened, or an object the parser cannot find; nothing is extracted or run
rtf_objects.shows: the objects embedded in the RTF: each one's OLE class (Package, Equation.3, OLE2Link and others), the file name and paths a Package names, and its payload's sha256

office_dde.does_not_show: whether a link would run, or the links of an encrypted document
office_dde.shows: the DDE links and field instructions in the document, DDEAUTO commands too

js_deobfuscate.does_not_show: strings an obfuscator's decoder functions compute (decoding them would run the script, so those calls stay as written); with no sandbox, the control-flow flattening and dead code of a script guarded by an obfuscator-style string array, which stay as they are; VBScript, or JScript.Encode scripts
js_deobfuscate.shows: the script (or each script block of an HTA or WSF) unminified, unpacked from its bundle and cleared of self-defending and debugger traps, as readable JavaScript

container_scan.does_not_show: what a chunk holds (nothing is unpacked), or a format unblob has no handler for; nothing is run
container_scan.shows: each chunk of a known format inside the file (archives, compressed streams, file systems, firmware containers, a payload appended to another file), found by its own bytes, with its byte range, and the ranges no format claims with their entropy

container_extract.does_not_show: what an extracted file does: nothing extracted is run or opened beyond its type; a format unblob has no handler for, an encrypted chunk's contents, or anything past the sample upload bound the extraction stops at
container_extract.shows: every file the container's chunks hold, extracted recursively, each with its place in the container, size, sha256 and file type; links by what they name, and what unblob refused (a member whose path or link leaves the extraction, a device file)

android_classes.does_not_show: what any of them does; classes loaded, decrypted or downloaded at run time (no code is run); the manifest, permissions and certificates, which apk_info reads
android_classes.shows: the classes the APK's or dex file's bytecode defines, each with its methods and their signatures, as JADX reads them

android_decompile_class.does_not_show: what runs at run time: code loaded, decrypted or downloaded while the app runs, or native libraries beside the bytecode; no code is run
android_decompile_class.shows: Java source JADX decompiled from one class's dex bytecode, inner classes too
